text:
maria: Quick sync — ran microburst speculative decoding tests on ember-14b int4 this morning. Short summary: 1.6x median token throughput in 50–150 token bursts, tail latency (p95) up ~12% on heavy quantized KV cache misses.
cheng: Nice. What was the baseline config? Full int8? batch size? region?
maria: Baseline = int8 static quant, no speculative prefill. Test config: int4 quant + microburst speculative on fastpath, prefetch depth=2, speculative window=8 tokens. Batching disabled (single-request microbursts).
oliver: Any quality diffs on our eval set? top-1 acceptance / rouge?
maria: Ran the small eval set (2k prompts): EM drop ~0.6%, hallucination score up 0.7pts (worse). Token-level KL shift small. Most regressions concentrated on math/code long-tail.
anya: Did you run paired A/B with same seeds? possible sampling noise?
maria: Yep, paired runs, same RNG seed where applicable, repeated 3x. Confidence intervals overlap but consistent trend on longform code.
cheng: How about cost numbers? GPU time per request?
maria: Per-request GPU ms decreased by ~35% median. So cost per token down ~30% ignoring error-retry cost.
oliver: Any ops risk? fallback behavior if speculative miss spikes?
maria: We patched fallback: if KV-miss rate > 6% for a model-worker, route to conservative path (no speculative) for 5m. Also added metric microburst.spec_miss_rate.
sre-bot: Incident guard created: alert if microburst.spec_miss_rate > 10% for 3m.
anya: Can we reproduce on Dedicated? env differences matter (NVLink shm vs local NV)
maria: Quick Dedicated run on dcap-2 showed similar speedups but slightly higher miss rate (8%) due to shard packing. We're tuning prefetch depth.
cheng: Thoughts on shipping as opt-in for Hosted? rollout plan?
maria: Proposal: opt-in flag per-customer with default off. Canary to 5% traffic, monitor EM/regressions and fallback. Docs + best-practice prompts for long code blocks.
oliver: For eval, suggest adding long-code focused holdout and a token-level alignment metric. Also add delta per prompt length bins.
anya: Also check quantized KV layout — maybe different cache locality causes misses.
maria: Next steps: (1) run 10k prompt holdout focusing on code/math, (2) tune prefetch depth and window, (3) run dedicated canary with 5% traffic for 12h. I'll open an ops ticket.
cheng: SGTM. Add me to ticket, will help with canary infra.
oliver: Thanks — useful notes. :thumbsup:
maria: Quick repro command for infra if helpful:
```
./run_bench --model ember-14b \n  --quant int4 \n  --speculative microburst \n  --window 8 \n  --prefetch 2 \n  --cases 2000
```
anya: Perfect, I'll start the 10k holdout tomorrow and ping results here.
cheng: Can you also dump per-prompt deltas into S3 path: s3://redwood-ml/microburst/1718529630/deltas.csv ?
maria: Will do. I'll include prompt length bucket, EM delta, KL, p95 latency, and spec_miss_rate per worker.
oliver: One more ask: add a quick smoke on model variants (ember-14b-cpu-friendly) to see if architecture interacts with speculation.
maria: Added to the ticket.
anya: thanks all.
